title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Mon 26 Oct
summary: No clear upslope today. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 16 stations (GW2260 Kula, Hamakuapoko Rd, Kaonoulu 1 and 13 more); Nakula stopped at 11:00; the Mesonet could not be reached on 18 of 56 updates.
